verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a dedicated 'Mirror a branch with another Git server' guide. It also documents importing GitHub repositories and keeping code, issues and pull requests in sync one way or both ways, which covers mirroring to and from at least one external server. Missing for 10: details of how generic (non-GitHub) mirroring works, including direction, whether whole repositories (not just single branches) can be mirrored, and scheduling or authentication; independent or hands-on corroboration of either mirroring feature.
